author: Michael Larabel
description: Back in March, Martin Wimpress stepped down as the longtime Ubuntu MATE leader and was looking for contributors to keep this Ubuntu derivative going with its GNOME2-derived desktop. That change in leadership paired with no Ubuntu MATE 26.04 release having occurred  led to some concerns among users, but the plan is still for Ubuntu MATE to continue moving forward...
title: Ubuntu MATE Is Continuing Despite No Ubuntu MATE 26.04 Release

author: Michael Larabel
description: Following the official Fedora 44 images released one month ago, Fedora 44 RISC-V images were published today for those wanting to run this newest Fedora Linux on RISC-V hardware...
title: Fedora 44 RISC-V Images Released, Including New "Omni" Kernel For Broader RISC-V Hardware Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: Linux's ufshcd-pci as the Universal Flash Storage host controller PCI driver has supported a variety of Intel devices to this point while for Linux 7.2 the first AMD device is set to be added...
title: AMD Support Being Added To UFS Host Controller PCI Driver In Linux 7.2

author: Michael Larabel
description: Last week I ran benchmarks of CachyOS with the BORE scheduler using its "linux-cachyos-bore" kernel option. The results didn't end up being as enticing as anticipated but the developer behind the BORE scheduler commented in the forums that he recently received reports from users experiencing game stuttering while using BORE that was attributed to CachyOS' default use of Ananicy-Cpp. So over the weekend I did another CachyOS BORE run without that CachyOS default...
title: Running CachyOS With The BORE Scheduler While Disabling Ananicy-CPP

author: Michael Larabel
description: Recent testing of the Intel Arc B580 Battlemage desktop graphics card has shown that the upcoming Linux 7.1 kernel release is delivering superior graphics performance over the current stable Linux 7.0 kernel.
title: Linux 7.1 Helping Intel Arc Battlemage Graphics Achieve Better Performance

author: Michael Larabel
description: The belated "This Month in Redox" was posted today for covering improvements made to this open-source, Rust-based operating system during the month of May. Most notable in May is seeing the Xfce desktop ported over to Redox OS...
title: Xfce Ported To Rust-Written Redox OS For Better X11 Experience

author: Michael Larabel
description: Canonical engineers are again evaluating the impact of building the Ubuntu Linux archive for the x86-64-v3 "amd64v3" micro-architecture feature level for its performance benefits on modern Intel and AMD systems. An amd64v3 archive is available of Ubuntu 26.10 for testing with the packages targeting this level that allows for AVX/AVX2 and other newer CPU x86_64 ISA capabilities of the past decade...
title: Canonical Experimenting With x86-64-v3 Packages For Ubuntu 26.10

author: Michael Larabel
description: Ahead of NVIDIA Vera ramping up, the upcoming Linux 7.2 kernel is adding the ACPI CPPC v4 support authored by a NVIDIA engineer...
title: Linux 7.2 To Add ACPI CPPC v4 Support Authored By NVIDIA

author: Michael Larabel
description: Flatpak 1.18 is out today for providing the latest improvements to this leading open-source app sandboxing and distribution tech...
title: Flatpak 1.18 Released With Integration For AMD ROCm

author: Michael Larabel
description: An interesting quandary has arose on the Linux kernel mailing list over maintainership of old, unmaintained code within the Linux kernel. Someone has stepped up to maintain an old, very rare file-system driver but admittedly doesn't even use it and just submitted basic fixes. Or is it just better removing that old code?..
title: Linux EFS File-System May Have New Maintainer - Or It Might Just Get Removed

author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to the SpacemiT K1 and K3 RISC-V SoC Device Tree updates sent out last week, the RISC-V T-HEAD Device Tree "DT" changes were also sent out last week ahead of the upcoming Linux 7.2 kernel merge window...
title: BeagleV Ahead & Lichee Pi 4a RISC-V Boards To See Working WiFi With Linux 7.2
